# ABS Asia Business Success Co., Ltd.

ABS Asia Business Success is a Thailand-based business services company supporting investors, employers, and international professionals.

## Core services
- Thailand BOI investment promotion consulting and application coordination
- Work permit applications, renewals, and expatriate coordination
- Business visa applications and extensions
- Procurement process, vendor sourcing, quotation comparison, and delivery coordination
